channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PCB e PSTU farão 'apoio crítico' a Lula e ao PT no segundo turno
item.description: Left-wing parties PSTU and PCB declared critical support for Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round. The stance reflects a strategy of left-wing alignment while maintaining criticism of the previous government. This support aims to consolidate the progressive base for the election.

item.title: Republicanos vê resistência do PL a Motta na presidência da Câmara
item.description: The PL party's bancada in the Chamber shows resistance to President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), according to national leader Marcos Pereira. During an event formalizing support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, Pereira clarified that the tension comes from the PL's elected base, not Flávio. He emphasized dialogue as the solution, noting Flávio's conciliatory profile. Motta, who supports Lula, did not attend the announcement, and the party may respect local exceptions like Paraíba and Pernambuco.

item.title: Valdemar admite que houve plano de golpe no fim do governo Bolsonaro
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the Brazilian Republican Party (PL), acknowledged publicly that there was a coup d'état plan at the end of Bolsonaro's government but stressed such an action would be unacceptable under a potential Flávio Bolsonaro administration. He also advocated for pardons for those involved in the January 8th riots and downplayed the severity of the coup planning.

item.title: UNE mobiliza estudantes no Rio por reeleição de Lula
item.description: Students from public schools and universities in Rio de Janeiro held a protest on Wednesday, 7, supporting Lula's (PT) re-election. The event, organized by UNE and secondary school entities, marched from Igreja da Candelária to Cinelândia, gathering participants advocating for educational and social policies.

item.title: PoderData registra nova pesquisa sobre Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: PoderData will release a new poll on voter intention for the second round between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), based on 3,000 interviews with a margin of error of 1.8 percentage points. The election is set for October 25, and the latest poll showed a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: Marinho manifesta “preocupação” com reunião entre Moraes e diretor da PF
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho expressed concern over a meeting between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Federal Police Director-General André Rodrigues, calling for transparency regarding the encounter.

item.title: Lula ou Flávio? Márcia Sensitiva fez previsão para o 2º turno das eleições
item.description: Medium Márcia Sensitiva told the Brazilian media outlet Metrópoles she does not see a chance of Lula's reelection and suggested mapping his political future. In the first round of the 2026 elections, Flávio Bolsonaro led by 1.87 percentage points over Lula, securing a spot in the runoff.

item.title: Reale Junior declara voto em Lula e critica Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lawyer Miguel Reale Junior, who authored the impeachment request against Dilma Rousseff, announced his vote for Lula in the second round and criticized Flávio Bolsonaro. In an open letter on Instagram, he warned of the risks of a 'dictatorship' with the PL candidate.

item.title: ‘Sou contra um Posto Ipiranga na Fazenda’, diz cotado para ser ministro de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Marcelo Kayath, mentioned as a potentialFinance Minister for Flávio Bolsonaro, opposes the idea of a 'super-ministry' or 'Posto Ipiranga', advocating collaborative governance. He stresses clear communication and political negotiation, but claims he never discussed positions with Flávio.

item.title: PSDB apoiará Flávio no segundo turno?
item.description: The national president of PSDB, Aécio Neves, stated that the party awaits statements from state directories to decide whether to support Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round or remain neutral, with the decision expected next week.

item.title: Cleitinho confirma apoio a Flávio no 2° turno em evento do Republicanos
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo, elected governor of Minas Gerais, confirmed support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential runoff during a Republicanos event in Brasília. Together with Tarcísio de Freitas and other party leaders, he reinforced the decision after a period of neutrality in the first round.

item.title: Lula fala em novo lema no 2º turno: 'Para o povo trabalhador, proteção; para bandido, a prisão'
item.description: President Lula adopted a new campaign slogan for the second round, emphasizing protection for workers and action against crime. He hardened the public security discourse, aiming to reorganize his political group after the first round.

item.title: Por virada, ministros de Lula montam força-tarefa e se revezam em entregas
item.description: Lula's ministers are organizing a task force to ensure key public works are delivered before the October 25 runoff vote, rotating responsibilities across cabinets. The strategy aims to recover from a weaker-than-expected first-round showing and expand outreach to centrist and right-leaning voters.

item.title: TSE julga caso Deltan Dallagnol nesta quinta-feira (8) após votação que o coloca no Senado
item.description: The TSE will rule on Thursday (8) on the case of Deltan Dallagnol, former 'Operation Car Wash' prosecutor who secured 2.9 million votes and a Senate seat from Paraná. The decision may affect his standing in the state's Senate delegation.

item.title: Estudantes fazem ato no Rio de Janeiro em defesa de voto em Lula
item.description: Students held a pro-Lula rally in Rio de Janeiro demanding public education funding, democracy, and social rights. The incumbent president seeks a second term against Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 runoff. The demonstration highlighted criticisms of the prior administration and warnings about constitutional threats.

item.title: Augusto Cury critica 'guerra de ódios' e promete se pronunciar em breve: 'Por favor, aguardem'
item.description: Writer Augusto Cury, candidate for president by Avante, criticized the 'war of hatred' in the 2026 elections and promised to speak soon, without officially supporting any candidate in the runoff. He received 2.89% of valid votes, placing third behind Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula.

item.title: Republicanos declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Republicanos party declared support for senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential election runoff, following a meeting between party leaders and Flávio. The announcement strengthens the coalition backing the PL candidate against President Lula.

item.title: O risco do cheque em branco: os limites da euforia com os resultados da eleição estão na política
item.description: The article examines the risks of euphoria regarding potential election outcomes, noting that a candidate's victory will not resolve structural challenges such as the fiscal crisis, strained relations between powers, and the lack of a reform agenda. Despite expectations of change, the economy faces external and internal obstacles, requiring consensus beyond the ballot box.

item.title: Com Moraes impedido, STF rejeita recurso que tentava libertar Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court rejected 3-0 a habeas corpus seeking to free Jair Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years for leading a coup plot. Justice Carmen Lúcia denied the motion and the appeal, stating the petition was unauthorized by the former president. Justice Alexandre de Moraes recused himself from the case.

item.title: Ato por reeleição de Lula organizado pela UNE leva estudantes às ruas do Rio
item.description: High school and university students organized by UNE held a march in Rio de Janeiro supporting Lula's reelection, advocating for free and expanded public schools, continuation of the Pé-de-Meia program, and protection of educational budget.

item.title: Lobista amiga de Lulinha diz que “já já a Kátia Abreu será rifada”
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Fábio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha), publicly criticized former senator Kátia Abreu after she confirmed criticizing Janja's role in Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign. In an Instagram post, Luchsinger suggested Abreu will be 'kicked out' soon, intensifying the controversy over differing positions within the federal government.

item.title: Republicanos oficializa apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno contra Lula
item.description: The Republicanos officially endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round against Lula, backed by Tarcísio de Freitas and other party leaders. Despite the alliance, no reprisals will be made against those who support Lula. The decision reflects the Centrão's strategy to align with the prevailing forces.

item.title: A nova ofensiva de coordenador de campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro contra Moraes
item.description: Rogério Marinho, campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, publicly questioned Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues over a meeting discussing dossiers involving Minister André Mendonça. Marinho raised concerns about transparency and potential electoral interference, demanding public scrutiny.

item.title: Vem aí o Desenrola de Flávio Bolsonaro? Eis a resposta de cotado a ministro da Fazenda
item.description: Marcelo Kayath, speculated to head the Finance Ministry under Flávio Bolsonaro, says any incoming government must adopt short-term measures to ease Brazilian households' debt burden amid high inflation and interest rates. He emphasizes long-term strategies focused on economic growth, job creation, and prosperity. Only Marcelo Kayath and Flávio Bolsonaro are mentioned by name.

item.title: Cabo Gilberto diz ter acionado TSE contra “TV Globo” por fala sobre Flávio
item.description: Deputy Cabo Gilberto (PL-PB) filed a request for investigation with the TSE against TV Globo over a comment by journalist Míriam Leitão about Flávio Bolsonaro. He alleges unequal treatment and cites Article 45 of the Electoral Law, partially struck down by the STF in 2018. The case also highlights debates on press freedom and equity in combating electoral misinformation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro volta a falar em 'redemocratizar' o Brasil: 'instituições têm que voltar a ser respeitadas'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated at an event that Brazil needs to be 'redemocratized', criticizing the Supreme Federal Court and advocating for constitutional changes such as lowering the age of criminal responsibility and judicial reform. He emphasized the support from the Republicanos party and reiterated that his proposal aims to restore respect for institutions and constitutional norms. Bolsonaro also compared his profile with Congress, a center-right majority, and mentioned the possibility of amending the Constitution if elected.

item.title: “TV Globo” marca para 23 de outubro o debate entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: TV Globo scheduled the debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for October 23, after canceling the first-round debate due to judicial issues. Prior to the debate, the network will conduct live interviews with the candidates, with Lula on October 15 and Flávio on October 16. Lula emphasized economic growth and criticized Moro and Dallagnol, while Flávio questioned irregularities in the 'Dark Horse' film and denied global warming.

item.title: Quando serão os debates presidenciais do 2º turno das eleições 2026?
item.description: The presidential debates for the second round of the 2026 elections are scheduled for October 11, 15, 18, and 23, organized by various TV broadcasters. Despite tensions caused by judicial decisions in the first round, both President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are expected to participate in at least one debate. Neither has officially confirmed their participation yet.

item.title: Candidatos ligados a igrejas não se elegem para Câmara e Alesp em SP
item.description: In the October 4, 2026 election, several candidates affiliated with major evangelical churches in São Paulo, such as David Soares, Cezinha de Madureira, and Gilberto Nascimento, failed to secure re-election to the Chamber of Deputies and the São Paulo Legislative Assembly. Their campaigns were overshadowed by FBI investigations alleging money laundering and passive corruption. New candidates were elected, signaling a shift in religious representation within São Paulo politics.

item.title: Há obstáculos ao plano de Flávio Bolsonaro para mudar a Constituição, explica Lenio Streck
item.description: Legal scholar Lenio Streck explains that despite Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) not having secured victory, his proposal to amend the Constitution faces formal obstacles such as constitutional clauses and the independence of the judiciary and public prosecutor's office. To approve constitutional amendments, it would be necessary to obtain a qualified majority in Congress (308 votes in the Chamber and 49 in the Senate, in two rounds), requiring alliances with the centrist bloc, since the PL will start 2027 with only 121 deputies and 28 senators.

item.title: Skaf ironiza Lula por falar do fim da 6 X 1 só na véspera da eleição
item.description: Paulo Skaf criticized Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for supporting the end of the 6 X 1 work schedule only before elections, calling the proposal a last-minute political move. Lula has advocated for reducing the workweek to 40 hours distributed as 5 X 2, keeping salaries unchanged.

item.title: Republicanos oficializa apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno da eleição presidencial
item.description: Republicanos officially endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential runoff, announced by party leader Marcos Pereira during an event in Brasília.

item.title: Sakamoto: Lula avança com 6x1 e Flávio tenta conter com maioridade penal
item.description: Columnist Leonardo Sakamoto notes that the debate over ending the 6x1 scale returns to the center of political competition, while the Bolsonaro wing tries to shift focus to other issues. Lula pushes forward, while Flávio attempts to hold ground with the majority penalty.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que tem 'asco' de Flávio e reforça que seu eleitor está 'livre' no 2º turno
item.description: Renan Santos, former presidential candidate from the Missão party, said in a live stream that he feels disgusted by Flávio Bolsonaro and criticized the runner-up's tendency to 'do business with complicated people.' He emphasized that his voter is free to choose in the second round.

item.title: A primeira agenda de Flávio no Nordeste após primeiro turno
item.description: After ACM Neto endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro in the Northeast, the campaign plans visits to Bahia, Pernambuco, and Ceará. The PL candidate seeks to expand support in the region, highlighting electoral growth and promising to deliver a message of prosperity.

item.title: Ex coordenador do PL jovem de SP declara voto em Lula nesta eleição
item.description: Bruno Fonseca, former PL Young coordinator in São Paulo, announced his vote for Lula in 2026 following a political trajectory including involvement in Bolsonarism and the MBL movement. His decision stemmed from disagreements with PL stances on workers' rights, violence against women, and LGBTfobia. Bruno produces left-wing content in Curitiba, addressing topics like economy and social rights.

item.title: André Janones: “Eleição só será virada nas redes sociais”
item.description: Deputy André Janones criticizes Lula's campaign as 'analog' and laments the first-round loss, attributing it to weak digital presence. He emphasizes social media as the key arena to reverse results in the second round, launching the 'Lula Army' on WhatsApp.

item.title: Governo prepara calendário especial da 6x1 e Alcolumbre diz que vai votar
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre agreed to vote on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule immediately after the first round of elections, following a consensus to avoid contaminating the campaign. The government, through Teresa Leitão, is pushing a special calendar to accelerate the bill before the runoff. The Bolsonaro-aligned opposition plans to block the expedited process and insists on following the internal rules of procedure.

item.title: Milhares participam de protesto em apoio a Lula no Rio
item.description: Thousands participated in a pro-Lula protest in downtown Rio during the election runoff. The demonstration, named 'Youth on the Streets for Democracy', marched from Candelária to Cinelândia, expressing opposition to the far right and Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy.

item.title: Janones brinca e diz que se bater meta Lula entrará em canal no Zap
item.description: André Janones posted a video with Lula inviting supporters to join a WhatsApp group, joking about reaching 5 million followers. Lula criticized the campaign as 'least organized' since 1989 and increased social media presence after first-round loss.

item.title: PF arquiva investigação sobre suposta interferência dos EUA nas eleições
item.description: The Federal Police closed a preliminary investigation into alleged U.S. interference in the 2026 elections due to lack of minimum clues of a crime. The case was never formally opened as an inquiry and was terminated without indicating involvement of Donald Trump's government in the Brazilian electoral process.

item.title: “A mudança é a gente”, diz Flávio sobre resultado do 1º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that the 1st round results reflect voters' desire for change and linked this to his 2nd round candidacy, urging PL mobilization until October 25th. He emphasized the party's congressional performance and the need to keep social media active to promote his campaign.

item.title: TSE alerta que indicação de 'faltou' em consulta a portal 'não significa que o eleitor não votou'; entenda
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) clarified that the temporary 'absent' indication in the Electoral Justification service does not mean the voter did not vote. Attendance data is still being processed and the situation is expected to be updated by next Saturday, when the necessary files will be finalized.

item.title: Campanha de Lula vai explorar nas redes falas de Flávio sobre mudanças na Constituição e aposta em mensagem sobre temor de fim de direitos
item.description: Lula's campaign is using social media to highlight Flávio Bolsonaro's statements about amending the Constitution, aiming to increase rejection of the opponent through a fear-based strategy. The PT campaign plans to emphasize the risk of setbacks in social and labor rights, especially regarding Judiciary reform. Lula relies on digital influencers and parliamentarians to strengthen its online presence.

item.title: Flávio diz que campanha de Lula vive “clima de velório”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL candidate, stated that Lula's campaign is experiencing a 'climate of mourning' after the first round of elections. The remark was made during a meeting with PL lawmakers and governors in Brasília.

item.title: Exército vê civil bolsonarista como ministro da Defesa se Flávio vencer
item.description: The Brazilian military leadership discusses scenarios for a possible victory by Flávio Bolsonaro, analyzing the potential appointment of a Bolsonaro-aligned civilian as Defense Minister. The armed forces assess the risks and opportunities of an administration resembling Jair Bolsonaro's profile, still recovering from damages caused by the last government. This scenario is considered one possible path to the Presidency in 2026.

item.title: Votar em Flávio é “desamor à democracia”, diz Reale Júnior
item.description: Miguel Reale Júnior claims voting for Flávio Bolsonaro is anti-democratic, as the candidate supports pardoning coup supporters and yielding to U.S. interests. He contrasts Flávio with the PT and Lula, arguing petista governments do not threaten institutional stability. Reale also warns against designating criminal factions as terrorist groups, fearing it could enable U.S. intervention.

item.title: Entrevista: Moro nega desconforto com caso ‘Dark Horse’, mas diz que ‘se vierem fatos, Flávio precisa ser cobrado’
item.description: Sergio Moro stated that Flávio Bolsonaro did not obstruct investigations into the Dark Horse case, but said he would be held accountable if new facts emerge. Moro emphasized the importance of defeating PT and Lula in the 2026 elections, reinforcing his opposition to the PT's political project.

item.title: Emissoras confirmam datas dos debates entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Broadcasters Record, Band, SBT, and Globo have confirmed the dates for the debates between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 runoff elections, but candidate attendance remains unconfirmed. The first debate will be hosted by Record on October 11, followed by debates by a joint pool of outlets on October 15, by Band on October 18, and by Globo on October 23.

item.title: Eleitor que mudou de cidade depois do 1º turno pode votar no 2º turno em outra seção? O que diz o TSE sobre voto em trânsito, transferência e justificativa no dia
item.description: An elector who moved cities after the first round must vote at their original polling station in the second round unless they obtain prior authorization for voting in transit from the TSE. Changing voting sections requires a formal request, and voting in transit depends on documented proof of relocation. Otherwise, the elector must justify their absence or regularize their status with the electoral court.
